title: Two-phase signing
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 6.2 Key Management; W3C Web Cryptography API; QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1. QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1: “Converting between the two is the single most common interoperability bug in HCERT implementations.”.

statements.label: Two-phase signing
statements.requirement: Issuance SHALL be two-phase: prepare returns the exact bytes to sign (the Sig_structure), the caller signs them by any means, including asynchronous ones such as WebCrypto or a remote KMS, and finish assembles the certificate and returns the HC1 string and the COSE bytes. For ES256, finish SHALL accept r||s or DER and SHALL always emit r||s.
